title: Beyond Empathy: Integrating Diagnostic and Therapeutic Reasoning with Large Language Models for Mental Health Counseling
abstract: arXiv:2505.15715v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold significant potential for psychological support, capable of generating empathetic responses and simulating therapeutic conversations. However, existing LLM-based approaches often lack sufficient grounding in structured diagnostic reasoning and diverse therapeutic strategies, limiting their effectiveness in complex counseling scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose PsyLLM, the first large language model designed to incorporate diagnostic- and therapeutic-oriented reasoning for mental health counseling. To develop PsyLLM, we design a novel automated data synthesis pipeline that processes real-world mental health posts collected from Reddit, where users frequently express psychological distress and seek community support. translated_title: 超越共情：将诊断与治疗推理融入大语言模型以实现心理健康咨询
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在心理支持领域具有巨大潜力，能够生成共情性回应并模拟治疗性对话。然而，现有基于LLM的方法往往缺乏足够的结构化诊断推理和多样化治疗策略的支撑，限制了其在复杂咨询场景中的有效性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了PsyLLM，这是首个为心理健康咨询设计的、融合诊断导向和治疗导向推理的大语言模型。为了开发PsyLLM，我们设计了一种新颖的自动化数据合成流程，用于处理从Reddit收集的真实世界心理健康帖子——用户经常在这些帖子中表达心理困扰并寻求社区支持。该流程将这些帖子转化为多轮咨询对话，并利用在国际诊断标准（如DSM/ICD）和多种治疗方法的指导下进行的大语言模型来……
tldr: PsyLLM是首个为心理健康咨询融入诊断与治疗推理的大语言模型，通过新颖的自动化数据合成流程，将Reddit心理健康帖子转化为基于国际诊断标准（DSM/ICD）和多种治疗策略的多轮咨询对话。
en_tdlr: PsyLLM is the first large language model integrating diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning for mental health counseling, developed via a novel automated data synthesis pipeline that transforms Reddit mental health posts into multi-turn counseling dialogues grounded in international diagnostic standards (DSM/ICD) and multiple therapeutic strategies.
